page0.text: No. I can't use a Command Spell here.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page0:1

page1.text:
I hesitate for a second.
My Command Spells, especially for an untrained Master like me, are too important. I can only use them three times.
Almost the instant I realize I can't just use a Command Spell so casually...
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page1:1

page2.text:
"Huh?"
I fall on my back.
I slam into the ground after being kicked from the third floor.
Calling it fatal...well it's likely fatal.
I managed to avoid falling on my head, but I wouldn't be surprised if I'd just broken every bone in my body.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page2:1

page3.text:
"Wh...y?"
Blood seeps from me.
It's coming from my chest.
My back seems fine; it looks like I survived the impact of the fall... So why...
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page3:1

page4.text:
...What is that thing...
...sticking out...
...of my chest as I lay looking up at the sky?
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page4:1

page5.text:
"Ha...zh...!"
My chest is opened up.
What looks like several swords protrude from my chest, together forming the shape of a flower in full bloom.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page5:1

page6.text:
It's as if someone shoved a bomb in my chest, and it went off the moment I hit the ground.
"Sa...Sab...er..."
I can't explain it.
I don't understand what happened to my chest.
So...so many blades stick out of me, like my entire rib cage burst through my body.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page6:1

page7.text:
I watch blankly as my body slowly dissolves.
"...A...ah...I need to hurry...to stop...it..."
I can't move.
The miracle that healed me from Berserker's attacks doesn't seem to be working with so many swords piercing me.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page7:1

page8.text:
My thoughts begin to fall to pieces.
Even if I were to try using a Command Spell, I don't even know what's happening anymore.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-11:page8:1
